svg.text: Blue: printed frame · orange: moving link · teal: fixed guide support · gray: roller envelope
Left end, looking along the axle
Front elevation, looking toward the rear
Shared end wall: bearing seat + front/rear skid ramps + pitch-stop boss
The orange link slides vertically. Its curved slot limits head pitch while the head pivots inside it.
Roller ends, pivot retainers, guide joints and powered lift remain unfinished. Do not print from this review.
Floor at z = 0; raised head travels 16 mm. Air-flex motion and full mass accounting are in the linked report.
